title: Boot-AVT: Asymptotically Anytime-Valid Testing with Degenerate U-Statistics via Bootstrap
summary: Many nonparametric tests are based on $U$-statistics that are degenerate under the null hypothesis. We develop Boot-AVT, a bootstrap procedure for asymptotically anytime-valid testing with these statistics. Using Brownian scaling and time inversion for the limiting Gaussian chaos process, we show that logarithmically penalized maxima over observed and future sample sizes have a common limiting null distribution.
